steps.note: Open the existing service RFQ on the buyer side so the vendor session can return to this event.
Move to the separate vendor portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the service RFQ from Vendor A's event list and enter its pricing round.
Verify the vendor portal shows the pricing submission as accepted.
Return to the buyer's session to verify the submitted service quote.
Open the buyer's comparison grid containing the vendor's activity-level response.
Verify every activity amount equals rate multiplied by activity quantity and the vendor total equals the sum of the activity amounts.
